invariants.rationale: The context is cast to HoodieJavaEngineContext and used, so it must not be null.
instantTime is used as an identifier for the operation and passed to another object; it must be non-null.
preppedRecords is passed to another method; a null list would cause failures.
bulkInsertPartitioner is an Option and is passed to another method; it should not be null as an Option should handle emptiness internally.
The size of a list is always non-negative if the list is well-formed.
